description: Use when you need company research, due diligence or a quick analysis of a business from its website domain and optional ticker. Do not use for private financials, credit scores, people search or businesses without a website. Returns JSON with a company research dossier in one call: domain registration and DNS, email and website security, latest news and, with a ticker, SEC financials, priced below the separate calls for 0.03 USDC per call. Typical response time 8000 ms (p95). Category: Data.

name.description: Company name for the news search (taken from the domain when omitted), e.g. Stripe

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

ticker.description: Stock ticker for SEC financials, US filers only (no financials when omitted), e.g. AAPL

name: blackwood_company_dossier

next.description: Suggested next paid call in the same family (call it in a loop when the task continues)

sample.description: Free fixed sample of the whole family

service.description: Service id of the suggested next paid call

tool.description: MCP tool name of the same call

url.description: Paid route of the next call

useWhen.description: When the next call is the right one

anyOf.description: x402 PaymentRequired (returned with isError when payment is needed)
